description: This file defines the TbBarsChart class, a specialized chart component for rendering bar charts within the Thingsboard platform. It extends a generic latest chart class, configuring chart options, styling, and data updates specific to bar chart visualization.

classes.name: TbBarsChart
classes.description: A chart class for rendering bar charts, extending the generic TbLatestChart with specific configurations for bar chart visualization.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the TbBarsChart with context, settings, DOM element, renderer, translation service, and optional auto-resize.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns the default settings for the bar chart, based on imported default settings.

methods.name: prepareLatestChartOption
methods.description: Prepares the chart options including axes, labels, and series configuration based on current settings.

methods.name: doUpdateSeriesData
methods.description: Updates the series data for the chart based on current data items, applying styles and colors.
